company.name: Catch
company.shortDescription: Catch is a platform that offers health insurance, retirement plans, and tax withholding for freelancers without benefits.
company.description: Catch is redesigning benefits to put people at the center of their own financial stability and security. For freelancers, contractors, and workers without access to employer benefits, Catch automatically handles tax withholding, builds long-term investment savings, and provides critical insurance products. In creating a personalized safety net, Catch envisions a world where individuals can leverage data-driven curation and timely insights to gain full agency over changing needs.

productsAndServices.description: Health insurance enrollment and coverage support for freelancers and independent workers who do not receive employer-sponsored benefits.
productsAndServices.name: Health Insurance

productsAndServices.description: Retirement savings tools that help freelancers set aside money for long-term financial planning without access to an employer-sponsored plan.
productsAndServices.name: Retirement Plans

productsAndServices.description: Automated tax withholding support that helps freelancers reserve income for estimated taxes and manage tax-related savings.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $12,000,000, or 59.7% of reported total funding.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,848,721 to $76,694,171, a 9.77x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
